message.content: The stock for Microsoft Corporation closed at 493.95 within a session that ranged from a low of 490.15 to a high of 495.19 with volume of 18.88 million shares, while the current price sits below the 20-day average of 494.34 and the 50-day average of 448.52 but above the 200-day average of 429.45. Technical indicators show a trend state of uptrend supported by an immediate support strength of 11 at edges between 491.30 and 500.60, with immediate resistance located at 506.35, and the 14-day average true range stands at 11.19 alongside a relative strength index of 56.17. The company has beaten estimates for eight consecutive quarters with an operating margin of 45.1 per cent compared to 44.9 per cent a year earlier, reflecting sales growth of 18.1 per cent in the same quarter a year before and 17.7 per cent on a year earlier. The most recent earnings reaction reported on 2026-07-30 showed an actual figure of 4.74 against an estimate of 4.21, resulting in a surprise of 12.59 per cent and a move of 15.51 per cent after the report date of 2026-07-29.
